result:
I've made all four changes to `Remap.cs`, and `dotnet build` succeeds with 0 errors. The 2 warnings are about the Grasshopper package version. I only built it. I haven't loaded it in Grasshopper to test it.

- **Rename:** the input "Value" is now "Number", with nickname "N".
- **Clamp:** the new boolean input "Clamp" (nickname "C", default false) sits last, after Target Max, so the existing input positions don't shift. When it's true, the result is limited to the target range. This works even if Target Min is greater than Target Max.
- **Normalized:** the new second output "Normalized" (nickname "Nrm") gives the 0–1 position in the source range. It is not affected by Clamp, so it can go below 0 or above 1 when the number is outside the source range.
- **Subcategory:** Remap now sits under "Mapping" instead of "Math".
